pack_metadata.title: Become eligible for Central Government procurement and submit and freeze a portal-received Central bid
pack_metadata.user_outcome: A supplier selects the tender-designated Central procurement channel, proves supplier and bid-specific eligibility, submits a complete signed bid before the portal deadline, and retains a portal acknowledgment that proves receipt but not correctness or award.
pack_metadata.central_scope: India Central Government procurement under GFR 2017 as updated through 31 January 2026, the Department of Expenditure goods and non-consultancy-services manuals, GeM, and the NIC eProcurement/CPPP portal. State and local licences are included only when a tender expressly makes them relevant.
explicit_exclusions: State, Union Territory, municipal, public-sector-enterprise, and defence-specific procurement rules unless a Central tender expressly incorporates them.
Works and consultancy bid preparation beyond routing the user to the applicable current Department of Expenditure manual and tender documents.
A universal entitlement to MSE, Startup, local-content, Make in India, fee, EMD, turnover, experience, or purchase-preference treatment.

Legal representation, litigation strategy, bank credit approval, commercial pricing advice, product certification, delivery, invoicing, payment recovery, or contract performance after the award boundary.
Any claim that registration, a frozen bid, or a submission acknowledgment proves responsiveness, technical qualification, selection, or award.

qualifying_questions.question: Which Central procuring entity issued the notice, and what are the tender ID, reference number, and official notice URL?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: The issuer and official notice establish scope, the controlling documents, the submission route, and the authority for clarifications.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Block bid preparation and submission until the notice can be matched to a Central procuring entity and an official portal record.

qualifying_questions.question: Is the requirement goods, non-consultancy services, consultancy services, works, or a mixed procurement?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: The procurement type selects the applicable manual, qualification logic, category, and bid structure.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: If unknown or mixed, obtain the tender's classification and controlling manual before applying goods- or services-specific rules.

qualifying_questions.question: Which submission channel does the tender name: GeM, NIC eProcure/CPPP, another compliant e-procurement portal, or an expressly permitted exception?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: CPPP publication is not itself proof that CPPP is the submission channel; the tender-designated route controls.
options: expressly permitted offline or hybrid exception
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Do not create an account or submit until the current tender and corrigenda identify the exact route.

qualifying_questions.question: For the offered category, is the bidder the OEM/manufacturer, an authorised reseller or dealer, a service provider, or another role?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: OEM/reseller authorisation, catalogue eligibility, MSE treatment, and technical qualification can differ by role and category.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: If the bidder's role or authority to offer the brand/category is unproved, mark the bid ineligible until the tender-specific evidence is obtained.

qualifying_questions.question: What is the bidder's legal form, PAN, GSTIN status, bank-account name, registered address, and authorised signatory basis?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: Portal identity, bid documents, bank instruments, and any eventual contract must refer to the same bidder identity.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Block enrolment and submission on unresolved name, PAN, GSTIN, bank, or signatory mismatches.

qualifying_questions.question: What category, specifications, licences, standards, past-performance, turnover, experience, service-location, and delivery conditions does the current tender require?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: Eligibility and responsiveness are tender-specific and must be evaluated only against the published conditions and corrigenda.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Treat every unstated or inaccessible criterion as unknown; do not infer thresholds, certificates, formats, or relaxation.

qualifying_questions.question: Does the bidder hold a currently verifiable Udyam micro/small registration, DPIIT Startup recognition, or another certificate expressly accepted by this tender?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: Status alone does not establish procurement benefit; the tender, role, category, registration scope, and current rules determine applicability.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Do not claim an exemption, preference, or relaxed criterion without a current verifiable certificate and an express tender/rule fit; traders and distributors require particular scrutiny.

qualifying_questions.question: Does the authorised portal user have a valid DSC/e-token issued by a currently licensed Certifying Authority and mapped to the correct bidder account?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: NIC eProcure requires portal enrolment and DSC mapping, and the token must remain under the authorised holder's control.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Block submission if the DSC is expired, not mapped, mapped to the wrong account, or controlled by an unauthorised person.

qualifying_questions.question: What does the current tender require for EMD/bid security, bid-security declaration, exemption evidence, amount, form, beneficiary, delivery mode, and validity?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: The rule-level framework is not a substitute for the tender's exact instrument and exemption conditions.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: No exemption and no security amount or form is assumed; block submission until the tender-specific requirement and proof are verified.

qualifying_questions.question: What is the portal server closing time, and have all corrigenda and deadline extensions been checked immediately before submission?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: The portal server clock governs actions and corrigenda can change the bid pack, deadline, eligibility, or security instructions.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Do not submit against a cached or superseded deadline; recheck the official portal and current corrigenda before freezing the bid.

qualifying_questions.question: Does the tender expressly require any place-specific trade licence, professional registration, labour registration, delivery permit, or local facility?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: A location-specific condition may create a bounded state/local dependency but cannot be inferred as a nationwide Central requirement.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Create a separate state/local verification gate only when the tender identifies the place and requirement; otherwise do not add one.

The DSC applicant and portal signatory must be authorised for the bidder.
The tender uses GeM or the post-award rule requires a GeM seller ID.
Current seller identity and account roles are reconciled.
The live GeM flow or bid requires the DSC/e-sign credential.
The tender designates NIC eProcure for submission.
Bidder identity and authorised user are reconciled.
A suitable valid e-token DSC is available for mapping.
The official detail page and document links are available.
All referenced documents and corrigenda are present and versioned.
Only tender-applicable verified policy status may satisfy or modify a checklist row.
The bidder is a reseller/dealer and the tender/category demands OEM or brand authorisation.
The current tender security clause and forms are available.
A claimed exemption requires verified status plus tender/rule applicability.
Every essential eligibility and responsiveness row is passed.
OEM authorisation is an essential tender requirement for this bidder role.
Security/exemption evidence and delivery steps are resolved.
NIC eProcure is the submission channel.
GeM is the submission channel; use the live GeM bid-specific flow, not NIC steps.
The final manifest is approved and no blocking unknown remains.
The portal displays a successful submission/freeze result.
The acknowledgment and final manifest are retained.
The procuring entity requests clarification/shortfall evidence or communicates rejection/non-responsiveness.
An adverse decision remains and a current review/grievance route is verified.
The official portal/procuring entity publishes an award or issues an LoA to the bidder.
A GeM seller ID is required before LoA/contract for an outside-GeM goods procurement.
For bid submission, follow only the tender-designated channel; maintaining both accounts does not authorise submission on the wrong portal.
A material tender condition is unclear and the published clarification window remains open.
A published response or corrigendum changes or confirms the control set.
The mapped certificate, bidder account, or signing operation fails before bid close.
The live account shows the correct authorised DSC and a successful signing readiness check.
Before the submission deadline, the bidder must modify, replace, or withdraw the submitted bid and the live tender/portal permits the action.
Retain the final live portal record: replacement frozen-bid summary after resubmission or withdrawal acknowledgment after withdrawal.

authorities_actors.name: Supplier/bidder and authorised signatory
authorities_actors.role: Supplies private identity and commercial facts, decides whether to bid, controls credentials, prepares evidence, signs/submits, and retains proof.
authorities_actors.channel: Internal governance plus official portals and authorised communications

authorities_actors.name: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance
authorities_actors.role: Issues GFR and procurement manuals governing Central procurement policy and procedure.

authorities_actors.name: Government e-Marketplace
authorities_actors.role: Nationwide end-to-end procurement marketplace for available common-use goods and services; operates seller accounts, catalogue/category, bid/RA, order, and helpdesk journeys.
authorities_actors.jurisdiction: India Central Government and participating public buyers

authorities_actors.name: Central Public Procurement Portal / NIC eProcurement System
authorities_actors.role: Publishes/searches Central tenders and operates NIC's online enrolment, DSC mapping, bid submission, acknowledgment, status, award, and technical-support routes.

authorities_actors.name: Tender-specific Central procuring entity and Tender Inviting Authority
authorities_actors.role: Defines the tender's eligibility, specifications, documents, security, timeline, evaluation, clarifications, rejection, award, and any grievance route within applicable rules.
authorities_actors.channel: Official tender page, authenticated portal communications, and tender contact details

authorities_actors.name: Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad
authorities_actors.role: Procuring entity used only for the bounded demo printer ink/toner empanelment scenario.
authorities_actors.channel: Official NIC eProcure tender detail page and IIT Dharwad tender contacts in the unavailable NIT

authorities_actors.name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises / Udyam Registration
authorities_actors.role: Registers and permits verification of enterprise classification; it does not prove tender-specific procurement benefit.

authorities_actors.name: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade / Startup India
authorities_actors.role: Administers DPIIT Startup recognition and its verification/application routes; procurement benefit still depends on current tender/rule applicability.

authorities_actors.name: Controller of Certifying Authorities
authorities_actors.role: Licenses Certifying Authorities and publishes active DSC/eSign providers; does not issue end-entity DSCs.

authorities_actors.name: CCA-licensed Certifying Authority
authorities_actors.role: Issues DSCs to end entities after its current verification and product process.
authorities_actors.channel: Provider selected from CCA's current active-services list

authorities_actors.name: Tender-accepted commercial bank or other permitted instrument issuer
authorities_actors.role: Issues bid-security/performance-security instruments when the tender accepts that form; validates beneficiary, amount, validity, and instrument data.
authorities_actors.channel: Bank branch or authenticated digital route stated by the bank and accepted by the tender

authorities_actors.name: Relevant OEM or brand owner
authorities_actors.role: May issue tender-specific reseller/dealer/manufacturer authorisation and product/category evidence.
authorities_actors.jurisdiction: Private commercial relationship bounded by tender and authorisation

portal_journeys.name: NIC eProcure active-tender discovery
portal_journeys.navigation: eProcurement System home > Active Tenders; search by Tender ID or Tender Title, choose sort, enter captcha, open the official detail page, and download the complete tender document set during its published availability window.
inputs_uploads: Optional organisation/category/date filters through the portal's other public search routes
portal_journeys.submission_proof: Not a submission route; retain official detail URL and downloaded tender documents as discovery/control-set evidence.
portal_journeys.tracking_route: Corrigendum, Cancelled/Retendered, Tender Status, and Bid Awards links on the same portal.
portal_journeys.exception_route: If detail/download fails, contact portal technical helpdesk and the Tender Inviting Authority; reject secondary mirror data as evidence.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Public list is captcha-gated; the demo tender's official detail page timed out during verification.

portal_journeys.name: NIC eProcure bidder enrolment and online bid submission
portal_journeys.authentication: Portal bidder user ID/password plus a mapped authorised e-token DSC; credentials and token/PIN must remain under the authorised user's control.
portal_journeys.navigation: Home enrolment option > login > DSC enrolment/mapping > My Documents as appropriate > exact tender > read/accept terms > attach required files and tender-supplied BOQ > enter security details as applicable > digitally sign > Freeze Bid > save/print bid summary. If a permitted pre-close change is needed, use the live tender's modify/withdraw/resubmit function and retain the final resulting record; do not rely on archived screen names.
inputs_uploads: Unmodified tender-supplied BOQ with only permitted entries
Tender-specific EMD/security details and matching scan/physical original when required
portal_journeys.submission_proof: Successful bid-updation message and portal bid summary showing bid number, date/time, and relevant submission details; print/save it as acknowledgment.
portal_journeys.tracking_route: Bid summary plus public Tender Status, Cancelled/Retendered, and Bid Awards routes; use authenticated portal communications when present.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Technical helpdesk for portal failures; Tender Inviting Authority for published-tender conditions. No technical ticket is a deadline waiver.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Current public help instructions are accessible. Detailed registration/two-cover/resubmission manuals linked by the current kit mostly date to 2018 and are not treated as current for volatile UI detail.

portal_journeys.name: NIC eProcure tender-status and award tracking
portal_journeys.navigation: eProcurement System > Tender Status > Search Criteria III for exact Tender ID, or use criteria I/II; enter captcha and search. Check Bid Awards and Cancelled/Retendered separately.
portal_journeys.submission_proof: Not a bid-submission route; save dated official status/award records as evaluation evidence.
portal_journeys.tracking_route: Repeat by tender ID and monitor official award/cancellation/corrigendum pages and procuring-entity communications.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Contact Tender Inviting Authority for status substance and NIC helpdesk for access/search failure.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Captcha prevents unattended retrieval; absence of a result is not proof of rejection, cancellation, or award.

portal_journeys.name: GeM seller registration, catalogue, bid/RA, and order learning route
portal_journeys.authentication: Public course index; sign-up/login is needed for interactive learning content. The live GeM transactional login returned HTTP 403 to the research client.
portal_journeys.navigation: Seller Journey > Registration & Account Management > Catalogue Management > Bid and RA Participation; use Order Fulfillment only after award. A 2024 official overview described category quadrants and incident-module concepts, but those details are stale and must be revalidated inside the live account/category.
inputs_uploads: Bid-specific documents and terms from the current transaction
portal_journeys.submission_proof: Use the live GeM system's bid-specific acknowledgment; no current public artifact wording was verified in this research.
portal_journeys.tracking_route: Live seller account/bid workspace and GeM incident/helpdesk ticket IDs.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Email helpdesk-gem@gov.in and retain the ticket; do not infer current live steps from old GeM PDFs.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: The current LMS confirms the journey structure and support email, but the transactional login was blocked and current GTC/incident/bid acknowledgment details were not publicly verified.

portal_journeys.name: Udyam registration and certificate verification
portal_journeys.authentication: Public information and verification routes; registration/update flows use identity and enterprise authentication specified by the live portal.
portal_journeys.navigation: Udyam home > New Registration when needed, or Print/Verify > Verify Udyam Registration for an existing certificate.
portal_journeys.submission_proof: Online Udyam certificate with permanent registration number and dynamic QR code.
portal_journeys.tracking_route: Print/Verify and Udyami login; verify current classification and certificate details.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Use the portal's grievance/CHAMPIONS route for registration issues; tender benefit questions go to the Tender Inviting Authority.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Udyam proves enterprise registration/classification, not tender-specific MSE preference or exemption.

portal_journeys.name: DPIIT Startup recognition and verification
portal_journeys.authentication: Application is through NSWS account; public Startup India page provides criteria, apply route, and certificate verification links.
portal_journeys.navigation: Startup India > DPIIT Startup Recognition > apply through NSWS by adding Registration as a Startup; use Verify/Download Certificate for an existing recognition.
inputs_uploads: Eligible entity details and supporting documents
portal_journeys.submission_proof: DPIIT Certificate of Recognition after approval; application/recognition is separate from any tender benefit.
portal_journeys.tracking_route: NSWS application status and Startup India certificate verification/download route.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Startup India toll-free support 1800 115 565 for recognition process; Tender Inviting Authority for procurement applicability.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Recognition does not automatically waive turnover, experience, EMD, or technical criteria; the tender/current rule must activate any benefit.

portal_journeys.name: CCA licensed-CA lookup for DSC
portal_journeys.authentication: Public lookup; application authentication depends on the selected licensed CA.
portal_journeys.navigation: CCA > CA Service to Public (Active) > Digital Signature Certificate (crypto token based) > select a licensed CA and use its authenticated application route.
inputs_uploads: Applicant identity and verification inputs required by the selected licensed CA
portal_journeys.submission_proof: Issued DSC/token and certificate details from the licensed CA; later portal mapping proof is separate.
portal_journeys.tracking_route: Licensed CA status/contact list, selected CA application status, certificate validity/revocation.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Issuance issues go to the licensed CA; CCA identifies licensed providers; portal mapping issues go to the procurement portal helpdesk.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: CCA does not issue end-entity DSCs and does not set the selected provider's price or issuance time in the cited pages.

portal_journeys.name: Demo IIT Dharwad printer ink/toner tender detail
portal_journeys.authentication: Intended public detail page; retrieval timed out during verification.
portal_journeys.navigation: Official NIC eProcure detail URL for the bounded demo opportunity; once accessible, download the NIT, schedules, BOQ, and corrigenda.
inputs_uploads: No uploads until the official pack is verified
portal_journeys.submission_proof: Unavailable at research time; use pj.cppp-submit only after the tender pack proves NIC eProcure is the submission route.
portal_journeys.tracking_route: Use Tender Status/Active Tenders with the exact tender ID after retrieving it from the official page or NIT.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Contact IIT Dharwad Tender Inviting Authority using the official NIT contact once obtainable; use NIC helpdesk for portal access.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Official detail page timed out; all scenario metadata and bid-specific facts remain assumptions/Unavailable, not Verified claims.

required_inputs.name: Official tender notice and identifier
required_inputs.when_required: Channel selection and bid discovery
required_inputs.format_validity: Current official URL/document and any superseding corrigendum; exact validity is tender-specific.

required_inputs.name: Exact tender ID/reference
required_inputs.when_required: Discovery, submission, and status tracking
required_inputs.format_validity: Use exact current identifier; no inferred or secondary-only identifier.

required_inputs.name: Supplier search profile
required_inputs.when_required: Bid discovery
required_inputs.format_validity: Goods/service category, keywords, location/delivery capability, organisation, and closing-date horizon; internal working data.

required_inputs.name: Entity constitution/incorporation or proprietorship evidence
required_inputs.when_required: Identity reconciliation, portal enrolment, and tender qualification when asked
required_inputs.format_validity: Current document and exact form are entity/tender-specific.

required_inputs.name: Bidder PAN
required_inputs.when_required: Identity, portal, and tender requirements
required_inputs.format_validity: Must match bidder identity; tender/portal specifies upload format.

required_inputs.name: GSTIN or evidence of non-applicability
required_inputs.when_required: Identity, Udyam, portal, pricing/tax, and tender requirements as applicable
required_inputs.format_validity: Current registration matching bidder; exact tender requirement not universal.

required_inputs.name: Bidder bank-account evidence
required_inputs.when_required: Identity, portal enrolment, payment details, or security instrument
required_inputs.format_validity: Account name must match bidder; exact document and age are tender/portal-specific.

required_inputs.name: Authorised signatory and portal-user authority
required_inputs.when_required: DSC issue, portal account, bid signing, and contract
required_inputs.format_validity: Current authority covering the exact bidder and act; tender/entity-form-specific.

required_inputs.name: Udyam certificate/verification result
required_inputs.when_required: Only when claiming MSE status or a tender requires it
required_inputs.format_validity: Current portal-verifiable certificate/classification and relevant activity; does not itself prove bid benefit.

required_inputs.name: DPIIT Certificate of Recognition
required_inputs.when_required: Only when the bidder claims recognised-Startup treatment
required_inputs.format_validity: Current verifiable recognition; tender must expressly support any relaxation/benefit.

required_inputs.name: Any other tender-accepted preference/exemption certificate
required_inputs.when_required: Only where the current tender expressly accepts it
required_inputs.format_validity: Verify registration category, scope, monetary limit, expiry, bidder role, and tender clause; no universal form/validity.

required_inputs.name: Authorised user's DSC/e-token
required_inputs.when_required: DSC mapping, readiness recovery, and bid signing
required_inputs.format_validity: Valid, unrevoked, suitable for portal, controlled by the authorised user, and mapped to the correct account.

required_inputs.name: Tender clarification question
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Supplier addressed to the tender's named contact/portal route
required_inputs.when_required: Before the published clarification cutoff when a material condition is unclear
required_inputs.format_validity: Written, clause-specific, non-confidential question sent through the exact tender-designated route; no universal cutoff is assumed.

required_inputs.name: DSC mapping/signing incident record
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Supplier, licensed CA, and NIC eProcure as applicable
required_inputs.when_required: When certificate mapping or bid signing fails
required_inputs.format_validity: Bidder account, certificate serial/issuer/expiry, exact tender, timestamp, non-secret error text/screenshots, browser/device details, and helpdesk ticket; never include PIN/password/private key.

required_inputs.name: Pre-close modification, resubmission, or withdrawal decision
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Supplier approved through its authorised signatory
required_inputs.when_required: Only before bid submission close when the live tender/portal permits the action
required_inputs.format_validity: Document whether replacing the entire bid or withdrawing, identify the superseded bid and current deadline, and obtain internal approval; a partial upload is not treated as a replacement bid.

required_inputs.name: Category/catalogue/product/service qualification evidence
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: OEM, competent regulator/certifier, supplier, or official portal as the tender requires
required_inputs.when_required: GeM category approval and bid-specific eligibility
required_inputs.format_validity: Tender/category-specific; verify current issuer, scope, models/services, validity, and upload format.

required_inputs.name: Complete tender pack including NIT, schedules, annexures, ATC/STC/GTC as applicable, and BOQ
required_inputs.when_required: Before clarification, eligibility assessment, security, OEM authorisation, preparation, and submission
required_inputs.format_validity: Complete current official version downloaded during the published availability window; superseded files cannot control.

required_inputs.name: All tender corrigenda/amendments
required_inputs.when_required: From discovery through final submission or pre-close replacement
required_inputs.format_validity: All current official corrigenda through the latest transaction time.

required_inputs.name: Tender-required past performance/experience evidence
required_inputs.when_required: Only if the tender requires experience/performance
required_inputs.format_validity: Tender-specific period, value, similarity, completion/status, and issuer; no universal threshold.

required_inputs.name: Tender-required turnover and financial-capacity evidence
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Auditor/tax authority/bank as the tender requires
required_inputs.when_required: Only if the tender requires turnover, net worth, solvency, or statements
required_inputs.format_validity: Tender-specific years, thresholds, form, issuer, and signing; no universal threshold or relaxation.

required_inputs.name: Tender-specific OEM/manufacturer/brand authorisation
required_inputs.when_required: When bidder role and tender/category demand it
required_inputs.format_validity: Exact form, tender reference, brands/models, territory, signer, and validity are tender-specific and unavailable for the demo.

required_inputs.name: EMD/bid-security instrument or accepted exemption evidence
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Tender-accepted bank/issuer or competent certificate authority
required_inputs.when_required: Before submission exactly as tender requires
required_inputs.format_validity: Tender-specific amount, beneficiary, form, validity, delivery, and matching scan/original; demo details unavailable.

required_inputs.name: Final technical/commercial bid files
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Supplier and third-party issuers identified by tender
required_inputs.when_required: Submission
required_inputs.format_validity: Exact cover, filename, format, signature, size, and content are tender/portal-specific.

required_inputs.name: Tender-supplied financial BOQ completed only in permitted cells
required_inputs.when_required: Financial-bid preparation and submission
required_inputs.format_validity: Use the exact current tender template without modifying/replacing it; tender controls entries and pricing basis.

required_inputs.name: Clause-by-clause eligibility/submission matrix
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Supplier derived from official tender pack
required_inputs.when_required: Assessment, final review, clarification, and rejection analysis
required_inputs.format_validity: Must be regenerated after every corrigendum; internal control, not official eligibility proof.

required_inputs.name: Pre-existing historical shortfall/clarification proof
required_inputs.when_required: Only in an authorised clarification and only if it existed by bid close
required_inputs.format_validity: Must pre-date bid close and fit the clarification request; cannot create post-close qualification.

required_inputs.name: Authenticated portal/procuring-entity communications
required_inputs.when_required: Tracking, clarification, rejection, and challenge
required_inputs.format_validity: Retain full message, headers/reference, timestamp, deadline, and attachments.

required_inputs.name: Official rejection/non-responsiveness decision and reasons
required_inputs.when_required: Rejection analysis and any challenge
required_inputs.format_validity: Current authenticated decision and stated reasons; absence of reasons is documented, not filled by inference.

required_inputs.name: Official award record and Letter of Award/Acceptance
required_inputs.when_required: Post-award boundary
required_inputs.format_validity: Match tender ID, bidder legal name, conditions, amount, and authorised issuer; bid summary is not a substitute.

required_inputs.name: Original eligibility and bid documents for permitted verification
required_inputs.when_required: If procuring entity verifies originals before LoA/contract
required_inputs.format_validity: Original/current documents corresponding to submitted copies; exact request controls.

required_inputs.name: Tender/LoA-specific performance security
required_inputs.when_required: Only after award/LoA as specified
required_inputs.format_validity: Amount, form, beneficiary, validity, and deadline are tender/LoA-specific and outside first-bid submission proof.

completion_proofs.name: Channel and scope record
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Internal record linking official notice URL, tender ID/reference, procurement type, procuring entity, controlling manual, and submission portal
completion_proofs.validation_method: Re-open the official notice and current corrigenda and compare every recorded identifier/route.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Prevents publication/submission-channel confusion and anchors the case graph.

completion_proofs.name: Bidder identity reconciliation
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Internal crosswalk of legal name, PAN/GSTIN, bank name, address, signatory, account roles, and OEM/reseller/service-provider role
completion_proofs.validation_method: Compare to current issuer records and tender-required evidence; public sources cannot validate the private values.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Prevents cross-document/account/contract identity mismatch.

completion_proofs.name: Policy benefit assessment
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: One row per claimed benefit linking current certificate verification, bidder role/activity, tender clause, and conclusion
completion_proofs.validation_method: Revalidate certificate on official portal and re-read the current tender/current manual clause.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Supports a narrow benefit claim or documents why none is claimed.

completion_proofs.name: Valid DSC/token possession record
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: DSC certificate details and crypto token held by authorised user
completion_proofs.validation_method: Check issuer against CCA active list, certificate validity/revocation, identity fields, custody, and portal suitability without recording PIN.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Supports account mapping and signing readiness.

completion_proofs.name: DSC mapping/signing recovery record
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Helpdesk ticket and live portal evidence that the correct authorised certificate is mapped and can complete the required signing readiness check
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match bidder account, authorised holder, certificate serial/issuer/expiry, non-secret error chronology, ticket response, and live result; exact recovery UI and SLA remain unverified.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Supports readiness after an incident; it does not prove any bid was submitted.

completion_proofs.name: GeM seller/account/category status
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Live account identifier, role assignments, category/catalogue approval, and incident ticket IDs as applicable
completion_proofs.validation_method: Validate inside the current live GeM account and bid/category; public LMS alone cannot prove seller readiness.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Evidence for GeM bid readiness or pre-LoA seller-ID requirement, not eligibility/award.

completion_proofs.name: NIC eProcure account and DSC mapping evidence
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Portal account identity and DSC mapping result
completion_proofs.validation_method: Log in through the official portal, confirm bidder/account identity and mapped certificate serial/expiry.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Proves enrolment/mapping readiness, not bid submission.

completion_proofs.name: Pre-bid clarification record
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Query receipt plus any official published response, corrigendum, deadline extension, or authenticated no-response status
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match the exact tender/clause, designated route, clarification cutoff, receipt timestamp, response publication, and resulting control-set update.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Supports interpretation of the current control set; silence does not convert an unknown requirement into a pass.

completion_proofs.name: Versioned official tender control set
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Official notice/detail URL plus downloaded NIT, schedules, annexures, BOQ, terms, and corrigenda with internal manifest
completion_proofs.validation_method: Re-download/recheck official portal and compare tender ID, filenames, versions, dates, and hashes immediately before submission.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Controls all eligibility, security, deadline, upload, evaluation, and challenge analysis.

completion_proofs.name: Completed tender eligibility matrix
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Clause-by-clause pass/fail/unknown matrix with evidence and issuer links
completion_proofs.validation_method: Independent review against the current official control set and private original evidence; regenerate after corrigenda.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Gate for bid/no-bid and final manifest approval; not official qualification proof.

completion_proofs.name: Tender-compliant OEM/brand authorisation
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: OEM-signed authorisation tied to bidder and tender/category
completion_proofs.validation_method: Authenticate issuer/signer and match exact tender form, reference, brands/models, scope, and validity.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Supports reseller eligibility only for the specified tender/scope.

completion_proofs.name: Bid-security or exemption compliance record
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Tender-accepted instrument/exemption evidence plus delivery/portal receipt where applicable
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match exact tender clause, bidder name, amount, form, beneficiary, validity, registration scope, and delivery proof.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Supports security compliance; rule-level exemption text alone is insufficient.

completion_proofs.name: Final bid upload manifest
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Approved list of every file/cover/slot, version/hash, tender clause, signer, and security detail
completion_proofs.validation_method: Two-person comparison to current control set, eligibility matrix, opened/virus-scanned files, and tender-supplied BOQ.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Pre-submission quality gate and post-submission comparison to portal summary.

completion_proofs.name: Frozen bid summary/acknowledgment
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Portal bid summary showing bid number, tender, submission date/time, and relevant details after Freeze Bid
completion_proofs.validation_method: Confirm successful update, tender/bid identifiers, server timestamp, and listed documents; compare with final manifest.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Proves received/stored submission and entry point for opening; does not prove correctness, responsiveness, eligibility, or award.

completion_proofs.name: Final pre-close replacement or withdrawal record
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Live portal record showing either the replacement bid's final submission/freeze identifier and time or the bid withdrawal acknowledgment
completion_proofs.validation_method: Confirm action occurred before server close, match exact bidder/tender, and for replacement compare the complete fresh submission to the approved manifest; only the final bid should be treated as operative.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Distinguishes the final portal-received bid from a superseded or withdrawn submission; does not prove responsiveness or award.

completion_proofs.name: Official evaluation/status record
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Official portal status, technical result, financial opening/ranking notice, cancellation, or retender communication
completion_proofs.validation_method: Retrieve through exact tender ID from official portal and record timestamp/source; do not infer intermediate states.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Tracks evaluation state and triggers clarification, rejection, retender, or award branches.

completion_proofs.name: Clarification response receipt
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Authenticated request, bidder response, uploaded pre-existing evidence, and portal/entity receipt
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match request scope/deadline and prove response did not change price/substance or create post-close qualification.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Evaluation record and potential review evidence.

completion_proofs.name: Rejection/non-responsiveness record
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Official decision/reasons and bidder's clause/evidence mapping
completion_proofs.validation_method: Authenticate decision and compare to current tender conditions, submitted files, and applicable evaluation rules.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Supports learning, debriefing, review, or next-bid remediation.

completion_proofs.name: Review/grievance filing receipt
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Receipt, diary/ticket number, or authenticated acknowledgment from the tender's named review authority
completion_proofs.validation_method: Confirm authority, route, deadline, challenged decision, attachments, and receipt timestamp under the actual tender mechanism.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Proves filing only; not a stay, acceptance, or successful challenge unless the applicable rule says so.

completion_proofs.name: Official award publication
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Official portal award record identifying tender and successful bidder
completion_proofs.validation_method: Validate on official Bid Awards/procuring-entity route and match tender/bidder identifiers.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Public award evidence; not a substitute for LoA/contract conditions.

completion_proofs.name: Letter of Award/Acceptance
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Authenticated LoA/acceptance to the bidder
completion_proofs.validation_method: Verify authorised issuer, tender ID, bidder legal name, accepted scope/value, conditions, dates, and required next steps.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Crosses the award boundary and triggers separate contract/performance work; not proof of completed contract.

tasks.title: Classify the procurement and select the controlling channel
tasks.user_goal: Determine whether the opportunity is a Central goods, services, works, consultancy, or mixed procurement and whether submission is through GeM, NIC eProcure/CPPP, or another tender-designated route.
tasks.trigger: The supplier finds a public procurement notice or wants to search nationwide Central opportunities.
steps: Open the official notice and identify the procuring entity, procurement type, tender ID/reference, submission portal, and controlling document set.
Use GeM where common-use goods/services are available and the tender is run there; otherwise follow the tender-designated compliant e-procurement route.
Do not equate publication on GeM-CPPP with submission on NIC eProcure.
tasks.tracking: Retain the official URL, tender ID/reference, issuer, portal, document version, and access timestamp.
tasks.rejection_handling: If the notice and portal disagree, stop and obtain a current corrigendum or written clarification from the Tender Inviting Authority.
tasks.escalation: For published-tender questions contact the Tender Inviting Authority; use CPPP policy or portal helpdesk only for policy/technical issues.

state_local_dependency.description: No state/local rule is inferred at channel-selection stage.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Unknown procurement type or submission route blocks all route-specific happy-path tasks.

tasks.title: Reconcile supplier legal identity and authorised roles
tasks.user_goal: Create one consistent bidder identity across portal accounts, PAN/GST records, bank details, signatory authority, bid documents, and any eventual contract.
tasks.trigger: The supplier has selected a potential tender or is preparing portal enrolment.
steps: Record legal name, entity type, PAN, GSTIN applicability, registered address, bank account name, and authorised signatory.
Resolve spelling, constitution, address, or signatory mismatches before account creation or bid signing.
Record whether the bidder is OEM/manufacturer, reseller/dealer, or service provider for the offered category.
tasks.tracking: Maintain an internal, access-controlled identity reconciliation sheet and versioned supporting documents.
tasks.rejection_handling: Do not paper over a mismatch with an affidavit unless the tender or issuer expressly accepts that remedy; correct the authoritative record or seek clarification.
tasks.escalation: Use the relevant issuer for PAN/GST/entity records and the bank for account-name or instrument discrepancies.

state_local_dependency.description: Entity identity is Central/private; a local licence is evaluated only if the tender asks for one.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Private identity facts are not proven by public sources and must be supplied and reconciled by the bidder.

tasks.title: Assess MSE, Startup, and tender-specific policy status
tasks.user_goal: Determine whether a current certificate and the tender's express conditions support any relaxation, preference, or security treatment.
tasks.trigger: The bidder proposes to rely on Udyam, DPIIT recognition, NSIC registration, or another preference/exemption certificate.

fees_duties.label: Udyam registration fee
fees_duties.applicability: Only if the enterprise chooses or needs Udyam registration; not a universal bid prerequisite.

fees_duties.label: DPIIT recognition application fee
fees_duties.applicability: Only for eligible entities seeking DPIIT recognition; recognition does not by itself prove a bid benefit.

steps: Verify the certificate on the competent authority's portal and capture classification, scope, and current status.
Compare the bidder's actual role and offered activity to the tender and the current procurement manual.
Record each claimed benefit separately and cite the tender clause that activates it.
For a trader, distributor, or sole agent, do not claim MSE purchase preference merely from Udyam registration.
tasks.tracking: Revalidate certificates and the tender clause before submission and after any corrigendum.
tasks.rejection_handling: If the portal or tender rejects the claimed status, submit the security/full qualification evidence unless an authoritative clarification confirms the benefit before close.
tasks.escalation: Certificate-status issues go to the issuing authority; tender applicability goes to the Tender Inviting Authority.

state_local_dependency.description: This task covers Central schemes and tender clauses only.

tasks.fail_closed_note: No status is converted into a benefit without a current certificate, role/category fit, and an applicable tender/rule clause.

tasks.title: Obtain and control the required Digital Signature Certificate
tasks.user_goal: Equip the authorised account user with a valid cryptographic token/DSC from a currently licensed Certifying Authority.
tasks.trigger: The selected portal or tender requires DSC-based authentication/signing and the authorised user lacks a suitable valid certificate.

fees_duties.label: DSC issue/renewal charge
fees_duties.applicability: Set by the selected licensed CA and certificate product; obtain a current quote before purchase.

timelines.label: DSC issuance time
timelines.applicability: Depends on the licensed CA, verification route, and applicant facts; do not infer a completion time.

steps: Use the CCA active-services list to select a currently licensed CA offering the needed DSC/token service.
Apply in the authorised individual's correct identity and complete the CA's current verification.
Record certificate serial/expiry and keep the token/PIN under the authorised holder's control.
Test certificate availability and portal compatibility before the bid deadline.
tasks.tracking: Monitor expiry, revocation, token custody, and mapping status; start renewal early without assuming a time-to-issue.
tasks.rejection_handling: For issuance or identity verification failure contact the licensed CA; for portal mapping failure contact the portal helpdesk.
tasks.escalation: CCA identifies licensed CAs; the selected CA supports issuance; NIC/GeM supports only portal use.

state_local_dependency.description: Licensed CA services are a nationwide regulated-private dependency.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Do not share tokens/PINs or assume an expired, wrong-PAN, or wrong-account certificate will be accepted.

tasks.title: Register and qualify the seller on GeM when the tender uses GeM
tasks.user_goal: Create the correct GeM seller account, catalogue/category position, and roles needed for the tender-designated GeM workflow.
tasks.trigger: The tender is on GeM or the procurement requires a GeM seller identity.

fees_duties.label: Current GeM registration/account charge
fees_duties.applicability: Verify in the live GeM flow and current terms before incurring or representing any charge.

timelines.label: GeM seller/category approval time
timelines.applicability: Account- and category-specific; no current public service time was verified.

steps: Use the official GeM login/signup route and current Seller Journey training for registration/account management.
Assign the primary/secondary account roles required by the live system and verify the authorised user's access.
Complete catalogue/category requirements and any OEM/reseller evidence demanded by the live category or bid.
Use the Bid and RA Participation course and the live bid documents; retain each account/category confirmation.
tasks.tracking: Use the seller account and GeM helpdesk; preserve ticket IDs for access, category, catalogue, or bid incidents.
tasks.rejection_handling: Do not infer missing UI steps from archived GeM PDFs; open a GeM helpdesk ticket and wait for an authoritative current response.
tasks.escalation: GeM support: helpdesk-gem@gov.in, as published on the 2026 GeM e-learning portal.

state_local_dependency.description: GeM is nationwide; any local delivery/licence condition comes from the bid, not registration alone.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Current public material confirms the journey areas but not a complete live signup/category transaction; verify every live screen and bid term.

tasks.title: Enrol the bidder and map the DSC on NIC eProcure
tasks.user_goal: Create the bidder account, map the authorised e-token, and stage reusable documents before the first NIC eProcure submission.
tasks.trigger: The tender designates the NIC eProcurement System for online bid submission.
steps: Use the portal enrolment option and create the bidder login in the bidder's correct identity; the DSC holder must be the bidder or a duly authorised person.
Log in and enrol/map the authorised e-token DSC to that account.
Upload reusable certificates and purchase-order details under My Documents only when current and applicable.
Confirm the token is not mapped to another account and is controlled only by the authorised user.
tasks.tracking: Record user ID, bidder identity, certificate serial/expiry, mapping result, and portal support ticket IDs without storing passwords/PINs.
tasks.rejection_handling: If mapping fails or a DSC is already mapped, do not create inconsistent duplicate identities; a certificate mapped to one account cannot simply be remapped to another and must follow the portal's inactivation/support route.
tasks.escalation: NIC eProcure technical helpdesk: 0120-4001002, 0120-4001005, 0120-4493395, support-eproc@nic.in.

state_local_dependency.description: NIC eProcure account enrolment is nationwide.

tasks.fail_closed_note: A portal account without a correctly mapped authorised DSC is not submission-ready.

tasks.title: Recover a DSC mapping or signing failure before bid close
tasks.user_goal: Restore the authorised bidder account's signing readiness without remapping credentials informally, exposing secrets, or assuming support extends the deadline.
tasks.trigger: The DSC is unmapped, mapped to another account, expired/revoked, not detected, or fails during the required signing operation.
steps: Stop repeated blind attempts and capture the exact non-secret error, timestamp, bidder account, tender ID, certificate serial/issuer/expiry, and device/browser context.
Verify the certificate's current validity/revocation and the holder's authority; keep password, PIN, private key, and token under the authorised user's control.
If the certificate is mapped to another account, use NIC support for the portal's inactivation/recovery route because current help says it cannot simply be remapped.
Send issuance, expiry, or revocation defects to the licensed CA; send account mapping or portal signing defects to NIC eProcure helpdesk and retain the ticket.
Reconfirm the live account/certificate mapping and signing readiness while the tender remains open.
tasks.tracking: Maintain a non-secret incident chronology and certificate/account/ticket crosswalk; continue to monitor the live portal server deadline.
tasks.rejection_handling: Do not open an inconsistent duplicate bidder identity or share credentials with support. If readiness is not restored before close, do not claim submission or a deadline waiver.
tasks.escalation: Certificate issuance/revocation goes to the selected licensed CA; DSC mapping/signing goes to NIC eProcure helpdesk; tender deadlines remain with the Tender Inviting Authority and live portal.

state_local_dependency.description: The incident concerns a nationwide portal and regulated DSC provider.

tasks.fail_closed_note: The current public help verifies the remapping boundary and support contacts, but not a complete current signing-recovery UI or service time.

tasks.title: Discover and identify a live Central bid
tasks.user_goal: Find an opportunity on the official portal and capture the exact tender identifier before relying on any description or deadline.
tasks.trigger: The supplier is ready to search by category, organisation, tender ID, title, or closing date.
steps: Search the official portal using tender ID/title/category/organisation and complete any captcha.

Open the official detail page, download the complete tender pack during its stated availability window, and record tender ID, reference, issuer, title, publication/closing/opening timestamps, and submission route.
Reject secondary mirror data as evidence and verify the same facts in the official tender pack.
tasks.tracking: Recheck Active Tenders, Corrigendum, Cancelled/Retendered, Tender Status, and Bid Awards routes as applicable.
tasks.rejection_handling: If the detail page or pack cannot be retrieved, mark the opportunity unavailable and contact the Tender Inviting Authority or portal helpdesk; do not bid from a mirror.
tasks.escalation: Published-tender content goes to the Tender Inviting Authority; search/access incidents go to the portal helpdesk.

state_local_dependency.description: Discovery is nationwide; the tender may later add a bounded delivery-location condition.

tasks.fail_closed_note: An indexed title or secondary listing is not enough; the official detail page and tender documents must be retrievable.

tasks.title: Freeze the controlling tender document set
tasks.user_goal: Build a complete versioned set of the notice, schedules, annexures, BOQ, instructions, ATC/STC/GTC where applicable, and every corrigendum.
tasks.trigger: The official tender detail page is available.

timelines.label: Bid close
timelines.applicability: Demo tender only; re-read from the official detail page and current corrigenda before any submission.

steps: Download every file from the official tender page during the published availability window and list filename, size, version/date, and source URL.
Capture the portal server closing time and bid-opening time.
Check all corrigenda and record which clause/file each changes.
Do not edit the supplied BOQ template except in fields the tender permits.
tasks.tracking: Repeat the corrigendum check immediately before submission and invalidate the checklist when a document changes.
tasks.rejection_handling: If any referenced annexure, price schedule, security form, corrigendum, or grievance/clarification clause is missing or ambiguous, stop and use t04.seek-prebid-clarification before its published cutoff.
tasks.escalation: Tender document issues go to the Tender Inviting Authority; download defects go to portal technical support.

state_local_dependency.description: No local dependency is created until an accessible tender clause identifies one.

tasks.fail_closed_note: An incomplete or inaccessible control set blocks the eligibility checklist, price schedule, security decision, and submission.

tasks.title: Seek a pre-bid clarification through the tender-designated route
tasks.user_goal: Resolve a material ambiguity before treating eligibility, security, documents, or submission instructions as satisfied.
tasks.trigger: A current tender clause, referenced document, eligibility condition, security requirement, deadline, or portal instruction is missing, inconsistent, or ambiguous.

timelines.label: Default latest query when tender states no clarification cutoff
timelines.value: Before 7 days of the bid submission deadline
timelines.applicability: Goods Manual default only; an express tender clarification cutoff controls when present.

timelines.label: Published response timing
timelines.value: At least 5 days before bid opening
timelines.applicability: Goods Manual procedure; material changes may require a deadline extension.

steps: Identify the tender's named clarification contact/channel and cutoff; if none is stated, apply the current Goods Manual's default timing rule for goods procurement.
Send a written clause-specific question without embedding unnecessary confidential information and retain a timestamped receipt.
Monitor the official tender page for the anonymised response, corrigendum, changed documents, and any deadline extension.
Update the tender control set and every affected eligibility/security/upload row; silence leaves the condition unknown.
tasks.tracking: Track query receipt, official response/corrigendum URL, publication time, affected clauses/files, and any changed submission/opening deadline.
tasks.rejection_handling: If no authoritative answer arrives before the decision point, treat the material ambiguity as unresolved and do not assert compliance or an exemption.
tasks.escalation: Tender substance goes only to the named Tender Inviting Authority route; portal delivery/access defects go to the relevant technical helpdesk.

state_local_dependency.description: Any place-specific issue must be stated in the tender and resolved as a bounded condition.

tasks.fail_closed_note: A bidder question or silence is not an amendment; only the official response/corrigendum can change the control set.

tasks.title: Assess every bid-specific eligibility and responsiveness condition
tasks.user_goal: Create a clause-by-clause matrix that maps each legal, financial, technical, category, experience, turnover, licence, and document condition to current proof.
tasks.trigger: The complete current tender pack and bidder identity/status evidence are available.
steps: Split each tender condition into one checklist row with clause/page, required fact, document, issuer, validity, and pass/fail/unknown.
Separate essential conditions from curable minor deviations only where the tender and procurement manual allow it.
Do not assume Startup turnover/experience relaxation; require an express tender provision and capability evidence.
Identify any bounded place-specific licence or facility requirement without generalising it nationally.
tasks.tracking: Re-run the matrix after every corrigendum and before final upload.
tasks.rejection_handling: A failed essential criterion or missing current proof is an action-required gate; seek timely clarification or skip the bid rather than assert compliance.
tasks.escalation: Ask the Tender Inviting Authority only through the tender's stated clarification channel and before its deadline.

state_local_dependency.description: Set to true in a case instance only if the tender expressly identifies a place-specific condition.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Unknown eligibility, turnover, experience, certificate, fee, security, or location conditions are not passes.

tasks.title: Obtain tender-compliant OEM or brand authorisation when required
tasks.user_goal: Prove that a reseller/dealer may offer the specified brand/category for this procurement in the exact form and scope demanded by the tender.
tasks.trigger: The bidder is not the OEM/manufacturer and the tender or category requires OEM/brand authorisation.

timelines.label: OEM authorisation lead time
timelines.applicability: Private and tender-specific; obtain directly from each required OEM before the portal deadline.

steps: Read the exact authorisation clause and form in the current tender pack.
Request authorisation from the OEM/brand owner covering bidder legal name, tender reference, products/brands, territory if required, and validity if required.
Verify signer authority and every annexure/format requirement before upload.
tasks.tracking: Track OEM request, signer, scope, validity, and tender reference in the eligibility matrix.
tasks.rejection_handling: Do not substitute a generic dealership letter when the tender requires a specific manufacturer authorisation form or scope.
tasks.escalation: Commercial issuance goes to the OEM; acceptability questions go to the Tender Inviting Authority before close.

state_local_dependency.description: OEM authorisation is private/commercial; territory becomes relevant only if the tender or authorisation says so.

tasks.fail_closed_note: For the demo tender, the official NIT/form was inaccessible; authorisation wording, brands, validity, and signer requirements are unknown.

tasks.title: Resolve EMD or bid-security requirement and any exemption
tasks.user_goal: Provide the exact tender-required bid security or prove a tender-accepted exemption without relying on a universal status claim.
tasks.trigger: The tender pack specifies EMD, bid security, a bid-security declaration, or exemption evidence.

fees_duties.label: Ordinary rule-level bid security range
fees_duties.applicability: GFR Rule 170 and Goods Manual ordinary framework; the tender controls the exact amount, accepted exemption, form, beneficiary, and delivery.

fees_duties.label: Demo tender EMD/security amount
fees_duties.applicability: Demo tender only; official NIT/BOQ unavailable.

timelines.label: Ordinary bid-security validity
timelines.applicability: Rule-level ordinary framework; follow any lawful tender-specific form and period.

timelines.label: Demo instrument delivery deadline
timelines.applicability: Verify from the official tender; do not rely on the portal's generic offline-EMD wording when the tender differs.

steps: Read the current tender's security clause, forms, beneficiary, amount, mode, physical-original rule if any, and deadline.
If the tender permits a bid-security declaration, use only its stated form and accept the specified disqualification/debarment consequences; do not substitute one merely to avoid an instrument.

If claiming exemption, map current certificate, bidder role, category/trade-group scope, monetary limit if any, and tender clause; MSE/Startup text in the Goods Manual is not represented as automatic portal acceptance for every bidder or bid.

If security is required, obtain a tender-accepted instrument or online payment from the bank/other permitted issuer and verify exact bidder name, amount, validity, beneficiary, reference, and delivery route.
Ensure scanned and physical details match when the tender requires both.
tasks.tracking: Track issuance, delivery/portal receipt, validity, return/release, and any invocation notice.
tasks.rejection_handling: If the exemption is not expressly accepted before close, supply compliant security if still possible or do not bid; never upload unsupported self-declaration as a substitute.
tasks.escalation: Instrument errors go to the issuing bank; portal upload errors to helpdesk; tender interpretation to the Tender Inviting Authority.

state_local_dependency.description: Bid security is Central/tender and regulated-private; no state/local rule is inferred.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Rule-level exemptions or ranges do not prove the demo bid's amount, form, exemption, delivery, or validity.

tasks.title: Prepare the technical, commercial, and financial bid
tasks.user_goal: Assemble each cover and schedule exactly as the tender requires, with no unsupported compliance assertion or altered BOQ.
tasks.trigger: All essential eligibility rows are passed and any required OEM authorisation/security is available.
steps: Map each upload/cover slot to the eligibility matrix and tender filename/format rule.
Complete technical and commercial schedules without adding qualifications inconsistent with essential terms.
Fill only the permitted cells in the supplied BOQ; do not replace or structurally modify it.
Virus-scan and open every file, confirm legibility, signatures, page completeness, and cross-document identity consistency.
Recheck corrigenda and portal closing time before the final package is approved.
tasks.tracking: Use a version-controlled internal manifest with document hash, signer, cover/slot, tender clause, and approval state.
tasks.rejection_handling: Any unknown essential requirement or missing final document reopens the relevant prerequisite task and blocks upload approval.
tasks.escalation: Content interpretation goes to the Tender Inviting Authority; private document issues go to the issuer/OEM/bank.

state_local_dependency.description: A local input is included only if the tender-specific eligibility matrix identified it.

tasks.fail_closed_note: A clean upload manifest does not cure missing eligibility or inaccessible tender terms.

tasks.title: Submit, digitally sign, and freeze the bid before server close
tasks.user_goal: Complete the portal transaction so the bid is received and stored before the controlling server deadline.
tasks.trigger: The NIC eProcure bid package is finally approved; for GeM, use the analogous live bid-specific transaction after completing t04.enrol-gem.

timelines.label: Portal close
timelines.applicability: Demo tender only; the live official portal server time and corrigenda control.

steps: Log in with the correct bidder account and mapped DSC; select the exact tender ID.
Attach each approved file to the correct cover/slot and complete the financial BOQ in the tender-supplied format.
Enter any required EMD/security details exactly and ensure physical/scanned details match if the tender requires both.
Accept tender terms, digitally sign, submit well before close, and click Freeze Bid.
Confirm the successful bid-updation message and inspect the bid summary.
tasks.tracking: Use the portal's bid summary and tender-status routes; keep a technical incident chronology if submission fails.
tasks.rejection_handling: A bid not frozen is incomplete/invalid. If time remains, first recover any DSC incident through t04.recover-dsc-signing, then use t04.amend-withdraw-resubmit only through a current permitted portal function; never assume support can accept a late bid.
tasks.escalation: Technical issues go immediately to NIC helpdesk with screenshots/timestamps while the portal is open; tender-content issues go to the Tender Inviting Authority.

state_local_dependency.description: Submission occurs on the official nationwide portal.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Successful upload without Freeze Bid is not a valid submission; the live tender deadline remains unknown in the demo until the official detail is retrieved.

tasks.title: Modify, withdraw, or replace a submitted bid before close
tasks.user_goal: Use only the live portal's permitted pre-close action and retain unambiguous proof of the final operative submission or withdrawal.
tasks.trigger: Before the portal deadline, the bidder identifies a defect, responds to a corrigendum, or decides to withdraw and the live tender/portal permits modification, withdrawal, or resubmission.

timelines.label: Modification, substitution, or withdrawal cutoff
timelines.applicability: The live tender and portal server time control; after the deadline the Goods Manual does not permit these bidder actions.

steps: Recheck the live tender ID, portal server deadline, corrigenda, and whether the required pre-close action is currently available.
For replacement/resubmission, rebuild and submit every required technical and financial document afresh; do not assume unchanged prior uploads carry forward.
Complete the live portal's modify/withdraw/resubmit transaction and, for a replacement, digitally sign and freeze the complete new bid before close.
Confirm the portal treats only the last bid as operative and retain the final replacement summary or withdrawal acknowledgment; label earlier summaries superseded.
Do not attempt bidder-initiated withdrawal or material amendment after the deadline or during bid validity.
tasks.tracking: Keep the internal approval, superseded bid ID/summary, final portal transaction, timestamp, updated manifest, and any support ticket as one chronology.
tasks.rejection_handling: If the live function is unavailable or completion cannot be proved before close, do not treat the intended change as effective; immediately preserve evidence and contact NIC helpdesk without assuming a waiver.
tasks.escalation: Technical transaction defects go to NIC eProcure helpdesk; tender-content effects go to the Tender Inviting Authority. A helpdesk ticket does not extend the tender deadline.

state_local_dependency.description: The action occurs on the nationwide NIC eProcure route.

tasks.fail_closed_note: The current rule-level action is verified, but current screen-level mechanics remain live-tender-specific and the detailed linked NIC manuals are stale.

tasks.title: Retain and validate the submission acknowledgment
tasks.user_goal: Preserve system proof that the portal received the frozen bid while keeping the proof boundary explicit.
tasks.trigger: The portal displays a successful bid update/submission result.
steps: Print/save the bid summary with bid number, tender ID, submission date/time, and listed documents.
Compare it to the final bid manifest and store both securely.
Record that the acknowledgment proves portal receipt/storage only, not correctness, responsiveness, qualification, ranking, or award.
tasks.tracking: Retain the portal-generated artifact, hashes/screenshots if available, support tickets, and final manifest through evaluation and contract/audit retention periods specified by the tender/organisation.
tasks.rejection_handling: If the summary is missing, incomplete, or lists the wrong documents/tender, treat submission proof as defective and use t04.amend-withdraw-resubmit before close only when the live tender/portal permits it.
tasks.escalation: Portal artifact defects go to technical helpdesk immediately; no helpdesk response is treated as a late-submission waiver.

state_local_dependency.description: Portal acknowledgment is nationwide.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Receipt proof is not a certificate that the bid is correct or eligible.

tasks.title: Track technical and financial evaluation and award status
tasks.user_goal: Monitor the official portal for opening, technical results, financial evaluation, cancellation/retendering, and award without inferring success from silence.
tasks.trigger: A bid acknowledgment has been retained.
steps: Search the official Tender Status route by exact tender ID and captcha; also check corrigenda, cancelled/retendered, and Bid Awards.
Record technical responsiveness/qualification separately from financial opening and evaluated ranking.
Preserve each portal notice and communication with timestamp and status.
tasks.tracking: Use only official portal status, procuring-entity communication, and award publication; keep a dated status log.
tasks.rejection_handling: A rejected or non-responsive result opens t04.handle-clarification-rejection; cancellation/retendering returns to discovery and control-set tasks.
tasks.escalation: Tender-status substance goes to the procuring entity; inability to access the status route goes to portal helpdesk.

state_local_dependency.description: Evaluation is by the Central procuring entity.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Technical opening, price opening, lowest quoted price, and award are distinct states.

tasks.title: Respond to clarification or diagnose rejection without curing an ineligible bid
tasks.user_goal: Answer an authorised clarification using pre-existing evidence and understand any rejection against the published criteria.
tasks.trigger: The procuring entity requests clarification/shortfall documents or communicates rejection/non-responsiveness.

timelines.label: Clarification response deadline
timelines.applicability: Use the procuring entity's authenticated communication; no universal response period was verified.

steps: Authenticate the request in the official portal/communication and record its deadline and scope.
Respond only with explanation or permissible pre-existing historical evidence; do not change price, substance, or create post-close qualification.
For rejection, map each stated reason to the tender clause, submitted artifact, portal summary, and evaluation rule.
Preserve the request, response, receipt, rejection communication, and evidence chronology.
tasks.tracking: Monitor the authenticated portal and official email/contact designated by the tender; log every communication.
tasks.rejection_handling: If the defect is an essential pre-close qualification not met at closing, do not represent it as curable; prepare for the next tender or invoke only an available review route.
tasks.escalation: Ask the procuring entity for a reasoned clarification/debriefing using the tender's process; proceed to t04.challenge-decision only if a review/grievance route is available.

state_local_dependency.description: Evaluation remediation remains with the Central procuring entity unless the tender identifies another forum.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Clarification cannot be used to submit a new qualifying supply order, new price, or material bid change after closing.

tasks.title: Use the tender's review, debriefing, grievance, or legal route
tasks.user_goal: Challenge a procedural or evaluation decision through the exact remedy and deadline available for that procurement.
tasks.trigger: The bidder has a documented adverse decision and a tender/manual/statutory route may be available.

timelines.label: Suggested pre-award review request
timelines.value: 5 days from bidder becoming aware of the circumstances
timelines.applicability: The Goods Manual presents a suggested grievance mechanism; apply only if adopted by the tender/procuring entity or otherwise legally available.

timelines.label: Suggested post-award grievance
timelines.applicability: Suggested manual mechanism only; verify the actual tender/organisation route and deadline.

steps: Read the tender's review/debriefing/grievance clause and identify the named authority, form, channel, fee, standstill effect if any, and deadline.
State the challenged act, tender clause, evidence, prejudice, and requested remedy without attempting informal influence.
Obtain specialist legal advice before judicial or statutory proceedings.
tasks.tracking: Retain filing receipt, diary/ticket number, authority response, and all deadline calculations.
tasks.rejection_handling: If no current route is verified, do not promise a remedy or time limit; seek written direction from the procuring entity and legal advice.
tasks.escalation: Use the named reviewing authority first where applicable; legal forums are outside this pack.

state_local_dependency.description: No state/local forum is assumed for a Central procurement challenge.

tasks.fail_closed_note: The manual's model review periods are not represented as universally binding.

tasks.title: Verify award and cross the post-award boundary
tasks.user_goal: Distinguish a public award/LoA from bid acknowledgment, then identify—not complete—the seller-ID, performance-security, contract, and fulfilment steps that follow.
tasks.trigger: The procuring entity publishes an award or issues a Letter of Award/Acceptance to the bidder.

fees_duties.label: Performance security
fees_duties.applicability: Post-award and tender-specific; verify amount, form, validity, and deadline from the LoA/tender before action.

steps: Validate the award publication and LoA against the tender ID and bidder legal name.
Prepare original documents for any permitted verification and confirm the contract remains in the bidder's name.
If the procurement was outside GeM, obtain the required GeM seller ID before LoA/contract as directed by the current Goods Manual, subject to the procuring entity's implementation.
Verify and complete only the tender/LoA-specific performance-security and contract-acknowledgment steps.
Hand off delivery, inspection, invoicing, payment, and contract performance to a separate post-award journey.
tasks.tracking: Track award publication, LoA, original-verification requests, seller-ID status, performance-security receipt, and contract signature separately.
tasks.rejection_handling: Do not treat an unofficial selection message or price rank as award; resolve bidder-name or condition discrepancies with the procuring entity before accepting obligations.
tasks.escalation: Award and LoA questions go to the procuring entity; GeM seller-ID issues go to GeM support; security issues go to the bank and procuring entity.

state_local_dependency.description: Any delivery-location permit or local facility is outside this pack unless expressly in the award/tender.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Submission acknowledgment, technical qualification, price rank, award publication, LoA, and signed contract are separate proofs and states.

demo_scenario.title: InkBridge Supplies — first Central bid for IIT Dharwad printer ink/toner empanelment
demo_scenario.purpose: Demonstrate a fail-closed first-bid route for a small authorised reseller against an identifiable Central goods opportunity while keeping every tender-specific fact scenario-only until the official NIT/BOQ is retrievable.
assumptions: InkBridge Supplies is a Dharwad proprietorship with privately supplied, internally consistent PAN, GSTIN, bank, address, and signatory evidence; none of these private facts is proved by public sources.
The business has a currently verifiable Udyam micro certificate but acts as a trader/reseller for printer cartridges, so it does not claim MSE purchase preference from that certificate.
The authorised proprietor has a suitable valid CCA-licensed-CA DSC/e-token and will map it to the correct NIC eProcure account.

The scenario targets the opportunity labelled 'Empanelment of OEM or Authorized Suppliers for Supply of Printer ink and toner Cartridges of different Brands of Printers or MFP or FAX machines for FY 2026 27', associated during discovery with IIT Dharwad, reference IITDH/MMD/RC/2026-27/01, and tender ID 2026_IITDW_922458_1.

Because the official detail page timed out, the title, issuer, reference, tender ID, dates, and NIC submission route are scenario assumptions that must be re-proved from the official page/NIT before action.
InkBridge is not an OEM and intends to obtain separate tender-compliant authorisation from every brand/OEM required by the official pack.
